messages:
Mira (Product): Quick sync thread. Execs want a single roadmap doc that ties routing policy options to launch contracts (SLA, data residency, pricing). Need agreement on scope: per-tenant isolation vs region affinity vs staged contracts.

Nina (Infra): Short: per-tenant isolation = dedicated pools (best isolation + latency). Region affinity = steering + fallbacks (cheaper). Staged contracts = a commercial wrapper: shielded for top customers, affinity defaults.

Luis (Architecture): We should define a "route contract" template: what we promise (latency p50/p99, residency, auditability), and technical enforcement points (routing templates, pool tags, model-variant mapping).

Priya (SRE): Ops needs for any contract: canary plan, automatic rollback triggers, noisy-tenant eviction threshold, and a per-tenant dashboard. Launch gate: 48h pilot with zero customer-facing errors.

Jess (Sales): Customers will pay for shielded. They want pilot SLA + legal wording around "data residency". We need a one-pager that maps tech gates -> legal commitments.

Hari (Legal): Note: we can't promise physical hardware custody. We can promise enforced residency (region-bound pools), customer-managed keys, and immutable audit exports. Will draft suggested contract language.

Ava (CustSuccess): Acceptance test checklist we use for pilots: synthetic latency probes from EU edge, audit-export verification, KMS BYOK proof, and retention policy checks. I'll own the checklist.

Mira (Product): Proposed roadmapping priority: 1) Staged contracts (pilot shielded for top 3 customers) 2) Improve affinity telemetry & fallback SLAs 3) Generalize per-tenant isolation if demand scales. Need decision by next Wed to include in Q plan.

Luis (Architecture): Technical note: model-variant compatibility is a blocker. If we route to different pools with different quantization/variants, we must define mapping + semantic regression tests. Recommend a 2-week spike.

Nina (Infra): Dev effort roughs: affinity telemetry + fallback rules ~3w; staged contracts (provisioning + billing hooks + runbooks) ~6-8w; full per-tenant isolation platformization ~10-12w. Estimates assume autoscaler & pool APIs reused.

Priya (SRE): Suggested numeric gates to include in the route contract template:
- p50 (edge->model) target: <50ms for shielded
- p99 tail target: <250ms for shielded
- fallback added latency: <300ms
- canary ramp: 0%->10%->50%->100% over 48-72h
- canary error budget: <0.01% customer-facing errors

Mira (Product): Sample route contract template (high-level) I sketched: "We will provide region-bound compute, audit logs delivered to customer bucket, and p50/p99 latency targets. Fallbacks may incur added latency up to X ms; model parity guaranteed for core model families."

Luis (Architecture): Small routing pseudo-config to help infra scope:
```
route_contract "eu-shield" {
  match: region == "eu" && tenant_tag == "shielded" => pool("eu-dedicated")
  else if region == "eu" => prefer(pool("eu-affinity"))
  fallback => pool("global-shared")
}
```

infra-bot: Reminder: attach RFC template at /rfc/routing-contract-template.md (auto). :page_with_curl:

Mira (Product): Action items:
- Nina: add cost & capacity estimates to RFC by Tue (ack?)
- Luis: run the model-variant compatibility spike (2w)
- Priya: draft SRE launch checklist + noisy-tenant eviction policy
- Hari: draft legal wording for route contract (residency + audit exports)
- Jess/Ava: recruit 2 pilot customers for staged contracts

Nina (Infra): ack. Will upload estimates and a minimal ops checklist.

Priya (SRE): ack. I'll include runbook links and canary alert thresholds.

Jess (Sales): I'll run customer asks and confirm pilots.

Mira (Product): If no objections I will lock the staged-contracts priority on Wed and start RFC. :white_check_mark:"
